args.command: echo '=== SYSTEM SERVICES ==='; systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-pager | grep -Ei 'desktop|commander|remote|mcp' || true; echo '=== ACTIVE/INACTIVE UNITS ==='; systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-pager | grep -Ei 'desktop|commander|remote|mcp' || true; echo '=== USER UNITS zenui ==='; sudo -u zenui XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u zenui) systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-pager 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'desktop|commander|remote|mcp' || true; echo '=== PROCESSES ==='; ps -eo pid,user,etime,args | grep -Ei 'desktop.?commander|mcp\.desktopcommander|remote.?commander' | grep -v grep || true; echo '=== UNIT FILE CANDIDATES ==='; find /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /home/zenui/.config/systemd/user /root/.config/systemd/user -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*desktop*' -o -iname '*commander*' -o -iname '*remote*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -100; echo '=== NPM/GLOBAL CANDIDATES ==='; find /opt /usr/local /home/zenui -maxdepth 4 \( -iname '*desktop*commander*' -o -iname '*remote*commander*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -100

meta.summary: Read-only locate Desktop Commander service/process on Mini before restart
